raw_sections.summary:
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Senior Network Engineer with 5+ years of experience across Cisco enterprise routing, switching, security, application delivery, and hybrid cloud networking. Operates as an L2 escalation engineer owning P1/P2 incident management and root cause analysis across OSPF, BGP, MPLS, Aruba, F5 BIG-IP LTM, Palo Alto, and Cisco ACI, with AZ-700 certification and active hybrid cloud networking exposure.
raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Senior Network Engineer | Accenture | Gurgaon
November 2024 – Present
Maintained 95%+ SLA resolution targets by owning 2–3 P1/P2 escalations per week across routing and Layer 2 domains in a Cisco enterprise network of 800+ devices spanning 4 data centres.
Execute 2–3 change requests per week spanning Cisco OSPF/BGP routing, Fortinet, Multicast, VLAN provisioning, F5/NetScaler load balancing, Azure network updates, and Cisco ACI fabric operations.
Restored routing stability across enterprise core by diagnosing and resolving Cisco OSPF neighbour adjacency failures caused by hello/dead timer mismatches, MTU inconsistencies, area type conflicts, and LSA propagation issues, meeting P1/P2 SLA targets.
Resolved BGP peering instability on enterprise edge routers by analysing neighbour state transitions, attribute manipulation, path selection issues, and next-hop reachability, restoring prefix advertisement within SLA.
Prevented Layer 2 instability by troubleshooting STP topology changes and resolving VLAN inconsistencies across Cisco access and distribution switches, identifying root bridge issues and resolving loops to maintain network stability. • Maintained high availability for 100+ production applications by managing VIPs, pools, nodes, persistence profiles, and
SSL certificate renewals across F5 BIG-IP LTM and Citrix NetScaler load balancers.
Manage Azure hybrid cloud network infrastructure including VNets, subnets, VNet peering, NSGs, UDRs, and Azure Front Door to support hybrid connectivity between on-premises and cloud environments.
Collaborate with the cloud platform team to validate and implement Azure network changes, reviewing peering setups, NSG rules, and subnet configurations before production push.
Perform Cisco ACI fabric operations including VLAN provisioning, EPG and Bridge Domain management, static port bindings, and L3Out subnet additions as part of routine data centre change management.
Manage IPAM and DNS on Infoblox, handling IP allocation and resolving DNS conflicts to support server provisioning across the enterprise.
Reduced repeat escalations by authoring detailed Root Cause Analysis (RCA) reports for all P1/P2 incidents, documenting findings and resolution steps to support knowledge management.
Network Security Engineer L2 | Genpact | Gurgaon
July 2022 – November 2024
Delivered zero-downtime migration of 500+ IPsec tunnels from policy-based to route-based architecture, improving routing flexibility and reducing tunnel management complexity across the enterprise WAN.
Designed and deployed IPsec Site-to-Site VPNs across multi-vendor environments using IKEv1, IKEv2, and PKI-based authentication for secure branch and partner connectivity.
Built Cisco DMVPN Phase 2/3 networks using mGRE and NHRP to enable dynamic spoke-to-spoke communication across distributed branch sites.
Configured OSPF over Cisco DMVPN tunnel interfaces for dynamic routing between hub and spoke sites, managing neighbour relationships, area design, and route propagation across the overlay.
Built and maintained Palo Alto firewall policies and IPsec VPN configurations, including security profiles for URL filtering, data filtering, and file blocking.
Executed Cisco IOS/IOS-XE firmware upgrades on edge routers during maintenance windows with zero unplanned downtime.
Network Engineer | Accenture (Payroll: 2COMS) | Remote
August 2021 – July 2022
Managed Cisco access layer switching for a US retail branch network, configuring VLANs and access ports for POS and kiosk deployments at new store openings.
Maintained PCI-DSS compliance across the retail network by configuring Port Security on Cisco access switches protecting credit card terminals.
Monitored STP topology changes on Cisco access and distribution switches, identifying root bridge issues and resolving loops to maintain Layer 2 stability across branch sites.
Configured HSRP/VRRP on branch routers for high availability gateway redundancy, ensuring service continuity during maintenance and link failures.
Handled pre-go-live network readiness checks for new store deployments, resolving VLAN mismatches and duplex errors before launch.
Network Operations Engineer | JindalX | Remote
December 2020 – July 2021
Provided 24/7 NOC monitoring and L1 fault isolation across a 100-device enterprise environment covering routers, switches, and WAN links.
• Performed L1 fault isolation for network outages, checking interface states, cabling, and IP reachability before
escalating to L2 teams.
Coordinated with ISPs and managed RMA cases for faulty hardware, following up on replacements to meet SLA timelines.
Resolved end-user LAN, Wi-Fi, IP conflict, and VPN issues, maintaining complete incident management records in ServiceNow throughout the ticket lifecycle.

Routing & Switching: Cisco BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, MPLS, TCP/IP, VLANs, STP/RSTP, EtherChannel, SVIs, HSRP/VRRP Security & VPN: Palo Alto (Panorama), IPsec Site-to-Site, IKEv1/IKEv2, Cisco DMVPN Phase 2/3, Route-Based & Policy- Based VPNs Data Centre: Cisco ACI (EPG, Bridge Domain, L3Out, Static Port Binding, Leaf Registration) Load Balancing: F5 BIG-IP LTM (VIPs, Pools, Monitors, SNAT, SSL Offload), Citrix NetScaler ADC Cloud: Microsoft Azure (VNets, Subnets, NSGs, UDRs, VNet Peering, Azure Front Door, Hybrid Connectivity) Platforms: Cisco ISR 4K, Cisco Catalyst 6500/3850/9300, Cisco Nexus (operational) Tools: Wireshark, SolarWinds, LibreNMS, Infoblox, QRadar, ServiceNow, Confluence
